name: Lemon-Rosemary Steak & Dressed Greens with Broiled Parmesan Tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small pkg fresh rosemary
1 ½ lemons
9 tomatoes
3 heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Slide rosemary leaves off the sprigs; discard sprigs and mince the leaves. Divide between two large bowls.
Peel and mince garlic; add to one of the bowls with the rosemary.

Zest lemons into the bowl with the rosemary and garlic; add oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the marinade, add the steak, and turn to coat; set aside. (Reserve lemons for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.primary_message: While the steak is marinating, juice lemons into the second bowl with the rosemary; add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest.
Meanwhile, halve tomatoes and transfer to a large baking sheet pan, cut-side up; season with salt and pepper. Place in the oven and broil until softened, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the tomatoes are broiling, finely grate Parmesan and place in a small bowl.
Peel and mince additional garlic; add to the bowl with the Parmesan, along with Italian seasoning, and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: When the tomatoes are soft, remove from the oven and top with the Parmesan mixture. Return to the oven and continue to broil until the cheese is melted and golden, 2-3 minutes more.
While the tomatoes are broiling, chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces, add to the bowl with the dressing, and toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad and broiled tomatoes between plates; top salad with steak and enjoy!
